question: At the latest finalized Ethereum mainnet block available when requested, return the address decoded from the ABI result of pauser() on USDC contract 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48.

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 1 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.call: Use function pauser() view returns (address), with no arguments, at the fixed toBlock. Return the lowercase 20-byte role-holder address with 0x prefix. It is the current mutable pauser role, not the token contract, caller, proxy admin or owner.
